programme.title: Kudrat
programme.desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

programme.title: Gumrah
programme.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.

programme.title: Anhonee (1973)
programme.desc: Dr Rekha admits a patient, Sunil, in her mental hospital. He responds to the treatment and recovers. They love each other but Sunil is not what he claims to be and Rekha too has a dark secret.

programme.title: Guddi
programme.desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

programme.title: Bawarchi
programme.desc: Shivnath (Harindranath Chattopadhyay) is the head of the Sharma family, who are so thoroughly argumentative that they have succeeded in scaring away every single cook they've ever employed. So when plucky young chef Raghu (Rajesh Khanna) shows up, nobody expects him to last long. To their surprise, however, he proves remarkably adept at satisfying everyone's independent needs. No sooner do they think him their savior than all the jewelry suddenly disappears.
